auth.note: If the server needs a key, name an environment variable in key_env under [engine].

verified.notes: Any server with an OpenAI-style model list (GET /v1/models answering with a data list) and /v1/chat/completions. The hint ports are common local defaults, checked only by ezbx init and ezbx engine detect; ezbx up and ezbx doctor contact only the configured url. Exercised through the gateway with several local servers, plain and streamed, with /v1/messages and /v1/responses translated.
